specs.title: E01 creates a new persisted v2 draft using UI and keyboard
E02 editorial preview has no learner effects, then publishes with current approval
E03 beginner help and CORE error are confirmed by the server
E04 all eight kinds persist through the learner UI on desktop and mobile
E05 disconnect before/after commit, reload and two tabs preserve one answer
E06 home, real map, route, session and review keep the pinned server state
E07 corrected and published route completes diagnosis, final and delayed review with reload
